title: War begins at Manila
text: Fighting breaks out at Manila on the evening of the 4th. By the 5th the Eighth Army Corps holds the high ground and the waterworks around the city. On the 10th MacArthur takes Caloocan.

title: Around Manila
text: The corps strengthens its lines around Manila. About the 12th an attack on the outpost on the Marikina road, by the waterworks, is beaten off.

title: Rising in Manila
text: On the night of the 22nd armed men who have slipped into Tondo set fires in the city and attack; the provost guard drives them out the next day. The 20th Infantry lands.

title: Preparing to advance
text: Both divisions are regrouped into three brigades each. MacArthur's column gathers behind La Loma on the night of the 24th.

title: Malolos
text: MacArthur's division advances from 25 March, fights across the Tulihan and at Polo, and enters Malolos on the 31st. The Republic's government has left and its army falls back on Calumpit.

title: Calumpit

title: San Fernando
text: MacArthur takes Santo Tomas and San Fernando and is halted there on 5 May. Lawton takes Baliuag.

title: Holding San Fernando and Baliuag
text: MacArthur is kept at San Fernando; Lawton scouts from Baliuag and takes Maasin. Gunboats find the mouth of the Rio Grande and reach Calumpit on the 10th.

title: San Isidro
text: Lawton routs the Filipino force at San Ildefonso and San Miguel and seizes San Isidro on the 17th. The Republic's government retires to Cabanatuan and Luna's army to Tarlac. Kobbe's column comes up the Rio Grande to Candaba.

title: The rains
text: Lawton and Kobbe meet at Arayat. The rains begin; San Isidro and San Miguel are given up and garrisons are left at Baliuag, Candaba and San Luis.

title: Cavite; Young sets out
text: Schwan's column and a Marine battalion clear Kawit and Noveleta on the 7th-8th and, with Lawton, enter San Francisco de Malabon on the 10th. In the north Young leaves Santa Ana on the 11th and enters Arayat on the 12th.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: The fall campaign opens
text: Lawton leaves Manila on the 15th. A Filipino attack on the Angeles outposts on the 16th fails with heavy loss. Young crosses the Rio Grande on the 17th, fights at Cabiao on the 18th and enters San Isidro on the 20th.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: San Isidro
text: Lawton's column strings out along the road behind San Isidro, short of transport. On the 27th Young pushes north-east and fights at the Tabaotin River.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: Santa Rosa and Cabanatuan
text: Young enters Santa Rosa on the 28th and halts three days, then goes on to Cabanatuan. His cavalry and scouts are let go only as far as Talavera and Aliaga.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: Three columns
text: MacArthur sets out from Angeles on the 5th and takes three days to reach Mabalacat. Wheaton sails on the 6th and lands at San Fabian on the 7th. Young leaves Cabanatuan for the north on the 7th.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: The Republic's army breaks up
text: On the 11th Wheeler charges across the Paruao River before Bamban and the 33rd routs Tinio's brigade at San Jacinto; the 36th enters Tarlac on the 12th. Young reaches San Jose on the 12th and Umingan on the 13th. At Bayambang on the 13th Aguinaldo decides to disband the army; Swigert's cavalry strikes his rear guard at Pozorrubio on the 14th, and he crosses into La Union, reaching Naguilian on the 17th.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: The pursuit
text: Lawton enters San Fabian on the 18th. MacArthur occupies Bayambang on the 19th and Dagupan on the 20th. Young forces the Aringay River on the 19th and takes San Fernando de la Union on the 20th. On the 23rd one company of the 33rd routs Alejandrino at Mangatarem.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: Into the mountains
text: March's battalion reaches San Fernando on the 25th and Namacpacan on the 26th and is sent after Aguinaldo. The Navy lands at Vigan on the 26th, and the 36th joins Fowler at Mangatarem. Tinio holds about 600 outside Namacpacan; Batchelor sets out down the Cagayan valley.
how written: Rewritten 22 Nov 2026 from Linn (S80) and the rows of that week.

title: Tirad Pass
text: March carries Tirad Pass on the 2nd, where Gregorio del Pilar is killed. Before dawn on the 4th Tinio's men attack Vigan and are beaten off; the same day Young and Hare's 33rd drive the Villamors from Tangadan Pass. Young enters Vigan on the 5th. On the 8th Howze catches Tinio's brigade in Abra and all but destroys it.

title: Cagayan
text: The province of Cagayan surrenders to a Navy force at Aparri as Batchelor's battalion nears the town. Lawton is ordered south. The sources read do not follow Aguinaldo further. Hare and Howze, in the mountains after the American prisoners, join forces on the 14th.
